  does are unit-tested with a fake Notifee (`logic/notifeeSurface.ts`). The notification itself is drawn by the system, so it
  has not been run on a real device; that needs a build on a phone.
- The deal notification is the system notification with the deal as its title and the watch as its text; tapping it opens the
  product. There is no separate "Open" button, because the tap does that.

  does are unit-tested with a fake Notifee (`logic/notifeeSurface.ts`). The notification itself is drawn by the system, so it
  has not been run on a real device; that needs a build on a phone.

  product. There is no separate "Open" button, because the tap does that.

  does are unit-tested with a fake Notifee (`logic/notifeeSurface.ts`). The notification itself is drawn by the system, so it
  has not been run on a real device; that needs a build on a phone.
- The deal notification is the system notification with the deal as its title and the watch as its text; tapping it opens the
  product. There is no separate "Open" button, because the tap does that.

  has not been run on a real device; that needs a build on a phone.

  does are unit-tested with a fake Notifee (`logic/notifeeSurface.ts`). The notification itself is drawn by the system, so it
  has not been run on a real device; that needs a build on a phone.
- The deal notification is the system notification with the deal as its title and the watch as its text; tapping it opens the
  product. There is no separate "Open" button, because the tap does that.
- Loading skeletons were checked in the app in light and dark; the catalog shows them too.

  cancels the run (Android with Notifee, in front or background; expo-notifications elsewhere). What it shows and what Stop
  does are unit-tested with a fake Notifee (`logic/notifeeSurface.ts`). The notification itself is drawn by the system, so it
  has not been run on a real device; that needs a build on a phone.

  does are unit-tested with a fake Notifee (`logic/notifeeSurface.ts`). The notification itself is drawn by the system, so it
  has not been run on a real device; that needs a build on a phone.
- The deal notification is the system notification with the deal as its title and the watch as its text; tapping it opens the
  product. There is no separate "Open" button, because the tap does that.
- Loading skeletons were checked in the app in light and dark; the catalog shows them too.

  cancels the run (Android with Notifee, in front or background; expo-notifications elsewhere). What it shows and what Stop
  does are unit-tested with a fake Notifee (`logic/notifeeSurface.ts`). The notification itself is drawn by the system, so it
  has not been run on a real device; that needs a build on a phone.
- The deal notification is the system notification with the deal as its title and the watch as its text; tapping it opens the
  product. There is no separate "Open" button, because the tap does that.

  has not been run on a real device; that needs a build on a phone.

  has not been run on a real device; that needs a build on a phone.

  does are unit-tested with a fake Notifee (`logic/notifeeSurface.ts`). The notification itself is drawn by the system, so it
  has not been run on a real device; that needs a build on a phone.
- The deal notification is the system notification with the deal as its title and the watch as its text; tapping it opens the
  product. There is no separate "Open" button, because the tap does that.
